VI.description: Writes one STRING control of a running dialog by NAME\2C then reads it back. Written for the two Delacor event types whose extra fields lvdqmh_dlg_fill3 does not cover - Round Trip needs `Round Trip (Broadcast)`\2C the name of the broadcast half of the pair.\0A\0AWHY A SEPARATE HELPER. fill3 writes a FIXED set of controls\3A event name\2C description\2C type\2C tester button and the module ring. Adding a sixth to it would make every caller pay for a field only one event type has\2C and the ring write there is Value (Signaling)\2C which this must NOT be - signalling a text field makes the dialog re-run its own event case and rebuild the arguments windows.\0A\0ACtrl Val.Set TAKES A NAME\2C so no control reference and no Controls[] index is needed - which matters because Controls[] order is read\2C never assumed\2C and an index carried from one dialog launch to another aims at the wrong control.\0A\0AThe read-back is typed `variant` on purpose\3A Ctrl Val.Get hands back a variant and the caller renders it. A write that reports error 0 is not evidence the value landed - the same lesson as Key Focus\2C where a silent no-op looked exactly like success.
